customer_question: All our API calls started failing this morning with CF-401. We didn't change anything. The token starts with cf_live_XXXX... if that helps.
resolution: The API token had expired, which returns CF-401 (authentication failed); its Last used date in the token list (Settings → API tokens in 3.x, Admin → API tokens in 4.x) matched the start of the failures. The customer created a new token, replaced it in the integration and confirmed the header format `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Calls succeeded afterwards. Reminded the customer never to paste tokens into tickets.
